page_title: BAR 2-0 OSA | Barcelona v Osasuna 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Fermín (Barcelona) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+2' The corner kick from Fermín (Barcelona) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
90+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) in, Pedri out.
88' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Marc Casado (Barcelona) replaces Raphinha.
88' The substitution has been made. Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) has replaced Alejandro Balde.
86' 2 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) latched on to a very good cross inside the penalty area and buried the ball inside the left post.
86' The attendance is 42058.
83' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Raul Garcia (Osasuna) offside.
83' Osasuna are seeing far more of the ball now.

81' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
80' Fermín (Barcelona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Sergio Herrera reads it well and gathers the ball.
78' Pedri (Barcelona) tries to find Ferran Torres, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
78' Total attempts – 22:3.
75' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Pau Cubarsi and he is replaced by Fermín (Barcelona).
74' Here comes a substitution. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Marcus Rashford.
73' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.

70' 1 - 0 Pedri passes to Raphinha (Barcelona), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:0.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch for Inigo Arguibide.
67' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
66' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
65' Alessio Lisci decides to make a substitution. Victor Munoz will be replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna).
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is replacing Ante Budimir.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Aimar Oroz cannot continue after picking up an injury.

63' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
63' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Adrian Cordero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
54' Barcelona are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
51' The ball possession is 82:18.
50' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
49' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
48' The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Alessio Lisci makes a half-time substitution. Iker Munoz comes on in place of Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
46' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
41' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Adrian Cordero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
39' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
37' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
35' Today's referee Adrian Cordero rightly decides to book Abel Bretones (Osasuna) for his harsh tackle.

34' Wasted effort! Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
33' Raphinha (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
32' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Half-chance! Jules Kounde (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
30' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
29' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Barcelona players look gutted.
25' The Barcelona players halt their celebrations as referee Adrian Cordero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
23' It is goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) puts the ball inside the net.
23' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
23' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Sergio Herrera sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
22' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
20' Raphinha (Barcelona) sprays a pass out to Marcus Rashford, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
19' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Joan Garcia stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
19' Barcelona players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
15' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ferran Torres, but Sergio Herrera displays great awareness to stop him.
14' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
10' PENALTY APPEAL by Barcelona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
8' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
6' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

5' Barcelona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
4' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' A spell of possession for Osasuna in an attempt to control the game.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero is introduced as the referee for today's match.
